subject.title: [Feature]: REST endpoint for session management in HTTP API integrations

question: Should OpenClaw expose dedicated `/v1/sessions/*` REST management endpoints for HTTP integrations, extend the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin instead, or keep session controls limited to WebSocket/plugin surfaces?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but adding mutating session and routing controls to the HTTP API is a public API and security-boundary decision rather than a routine bug fix.

options.title: Approve dedicated REST session management
options.body: Implement reset/status/compact/model/reasoning routes as a focused Gateway HTTP layer over existing session handlers with explicit operator-scope, reserved-key, rate-limit, docs, and tests coverage.

options.title: Use admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Expand and document the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin as the intended HTTP control-plane path, avoiding a second dedicated `/v1/sessions/*` API.

options.title: Defer mutating HTTP controls
options.body: Keep HTTP integrations on chat completions plus WebSocket/plugin surfaces until maintainers are ready to own a broader REST control-plane contract.

recommendation.title: Approve dedicated REST session management
recommendation.body: Implement reset/status/compact/model/reasoning routes as a focused Gateway HTTP layer over existing session handlers with explicit operator-scope, reserved-key, rate-limit, docs, and tests coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This account authored the original OpenAI-compatible HTTP surface and recently scoped this issue as a REST session-control product/security decision.
